summary: A real page: 20 rows from SQLite rendered through a template, with every Renox default on (CSP, session, CSRF, auth, locale, error pages). Renox serves 9× Laravel Octane and 16× PHP-FPM, at a tenth of the latency and a tenth of the memory, and keeps about two thirds of bare Axum's throughput.
note: Measured 2026-10-07 on an Intel i7-6700: each server pinned to 2 cores and 1 GB in Docker, oha with 64 connections for 15 s after a 5 s warm-up. The raw numbers and the bare-route results are in benchmarks/RESULTS.md.
